name: Centerfield Ltd
notes:
Centerfield Ltd, trading under the brand C-Servers (available at c-servers.co.uk), is your new global data company. Focusing on disruption and innovation, we strive to provide the best solutions for a Free Internet, prioritizing IPv6-first based peerings and solutions. We offer high quality, wide-reaching Web Hosting, VPS, Dedicated Servers and other specialized products and services.

Open peering policy is the norm at AS214556, prioritizing IPv6 over IPv4 peering agreements, but also available for IPv4 agreements. Strong preference for settlement-free peerings. At least a /48 IPv6 must be available on the ASN wishing to execute a peering agreement with AS214566. Agreements are executed in English, Portuguese and Spanish, solely depending on the outbound NOC primary language.
